Spatial plots of cell types and confidence scores

Source: R/plotting.R
plotSpatial.Rd

Plots the cells of one image, highlighting a cell type or group, or showing bootstrap confidence scores.

Usage

plotWeightedSpatialPair(
  spe,
  cellTypeTree,
  confList,
  imageID,
  groupA,
  subtypeA,
  groupB,
  subtypeB,
  encoding = c("alpha", "colour"),
  cellSize = 1
)

plotHardSpatialPair(
  spe,
  imageID,
  subtypeA,
  subtypeB,
  cellTypeTree = NULL,
  cellSize = 1
)

plotWeightedSpatial(
  spe,
  cellTypeTree,
  confList,
  imageID,
  targetGroup,
  targetSubtype,
  cellSize = 1
)

plotOriginalLabelSpatial(spe, cellTypeTree, imageID, targetGroup, cellSize = 1)

Arguments

spe

A SummarizedExperiment (e.g. a SpatialExperiment) with a cell ID, cell type, image and coordinates for every cell in the form given by getCellData() (cellID, cellType, imageID, x and y).

cellTypeTree

A cell type tree, see cellTypeTree. Optional for plotHardSpatialPair(), where it is only needed to use a group name as a label.

confList

Confidence list from bootstrapLineageConfidence().

imageID

The image to plot. An error is raised if it is not an image in the data.

groupA, groupB, targetGroup

Group names. An error is raised for a group that has no cells in the data.

subtypeA, subtypeB, targetSubtype

Cell types within the groups, which must have confidence scores in confList (for plotHardSpatialPair(), a cell type or a group name in the data).

encoding

How to show the confidence scores: "alpha" (the default), as transparency, or "colour", as a colour gradient. Either way each of the two cell types has its own legend.

cellSize

Size of the highlighted cells, the ones drawn in colour. The grey background cells always have size 0.7.

Value

A ggplot object.

Examples

data(lungSubset)
data(lungCellTypeTree)
data(lungConfList)
plotHardSpatialPair(lungSubset, "VUHD113", "Mast", "Proliferating FBs",
    lungCellTypeTree)

plotWeightedSpatial(lungSubset, lungCellTypeTree, lungConfList, "VUHD113",
    "Endothelial lineage", "Arteriole")

plotOriginalLabelSpatial(lungSubset, lungCellTypeTree, "VUHD113",
    "Endothelial lineage")

if (requireNamespace("ggnewscale", quietly = TRUE)) {
    plotWeightedSpatialPair(lungSubset, lungCellTypeTree, lungConfList,
        "VUHD113", "Granulocytes", "Mast", "Fibroblast lineage",
        "Proliferating FBs")
}
